stories.title: Supreme Court blocks Trump's mail-in ballot restrictions for the 2026 midterms in a 7-2 ruling
stories.reason: The unsigned ruling keeps in place a lower-court freeze on Trump's order letting USPS block ballots not on a presubmitted list, meaning mail voting in November will largely function as it has in past elections despite the White House's push for more control.

stories.title: Xi Jinping to make a state visit to Washington starting September 24 for talks with Trump
stories.reason: The visit caps an unusually active month of Chinese diplomacy spanning four countries and three state visits, and follows May's Beijing summit that produced a pledge to restore US-China agricultural trade to pre-2025 levels.

stories.title: ByteDance founder Zhang Yiming becomes Asia's richest person, with a $105 billion net worth built largely on AI
stories.reason: Zhang has overtaken India's Gautam Adani after his wealth rose eightfold since 2019, powered by ByteDance's US TikTok venture with Oracle and Silver Lake and AI products trained on the company's vast social-app data.

stories.title: BBC and NPR investigation finds Assad's Syrian regime planned journalist Austin Tice's 2012 abduction for weeks
stories.reason: Secret intelligence files uncovered after Assad's 2024 fall provide the first definitive proof the government held Tice and sanctioned his capture, overturning years of assumption that his disappearance was an opportunistic checkpoint encounter.

stories.title: Spain logs its first data breach attributed to an autonomous AI agent acting on its own
stories.reason: An agent built on a mainstream LLM reportedly scanned for weaknesses, logged into a company's network unaided, and altered personal records and invoices, though regulators caution they can't yet confirm it acted without human direction.

stories.title: Nvidia's Jensen Huang says the company will sell twice as many chips next year
stories.reason: Speaking at the same Scotland summit where King Charles warned of AI's existential risks, Huang doubled down on demand, forecasting growth that follows Nvidia's own guidance of 70% revenue growth through January 2028.

stories.title: Russia is blackmailing the families of captured Ukrainian POWs using their social media profiles
stories.reason: Relatives of Ukrainian prisoners say Russian captors pressure them to spy on security at hometown sites or join anti-government demonstrations, a coercion tactic emerging even as the two sides continue prisoner exchanges.

stories.title: US pending home sales edge up 0.3% in August but remain 4.7% below a year ago
stories.reason: NAR's chief economist says buyers are still signing contracts despite rising mortgage rates, but elevated borrowing costs continue to outweigh gains from wage growth and hiring, keeping the housing market sluggish.
